title: Secondary-model repairs and non-blocking Ensemble policy
scope: Resolve, repair, or explicitly defer the Phase 6 secondary-model findings without expanding the required PXD scope or allowing optional Ensemble evaluation to block the core refactor.

repaired: The complete fitted artifact remains persisted, including charge-stratified parameters, null window, TEV transform, extrapolation settings, and the reference candidate-count distribution.

Artifact loading now rejects unsupported schema/model versions, invalid windows, nonfinite or nonpositive scaling state, unsupported transforms, empty or unsorted candidate-count distributions, and invalid charge metadata.

evidence.refit_with_locked_window: Exact ISB grid, fitted-state, MS2Rescore, and target-only parity; target-only Level-4 counts 558 PSMs, 44 peptides, and 10 proteins.
evidence.reuse_dataset_artifact: Diagnostic Level-4 counts 6479 PSMs, 291 peptides, and 17 proteins; materially different from legacy/refit and therefore not release eligible.

lower_order.decision: Retain refit_with_locked_window as the parity interpretation, reject reuse as a production assumption, and keep Lower Order out of Ensemble until candidate-count normalization/transfer is repaired.

artifact_v1_present: cross-validation seed, fold count, and fold sizes
artifact_v1_insufficient: explicit fold membership or reconstruction rule
explicit positive and null training rules
nokoi.parity: Frozen fit, selected window, optimized counts, and target-only behavior failed Phase 6 parity.
nokoi.decision: The workflow refuses to treat Nokoi v1 as a portable reusable artifact. Nokoi is excluded from the first refactor release rather than silently retrained under reuse semantics.

msfdr.passed: All 59 frozen unannotated grid points, feasibility decisions, the selected 9-13 window, and fitted parameters matched exactly.
msfdr.unresolved: Regenerated macOS MS2PIP/DeepLC annotations differ from the frozen Linux environment and downstream counts exceed tolerance.
msfdr.decision: Exclude from Ensemble until the annotation environment is reproduced or declared platform-robustness parity passes.

msfdr2_smix.passed: All 69 frozen unannotated grid points, feasibility decisions, the selected 9-17 window, and fitted parameters matched exactly.
msfdr2_smix.unresolved: Regenerated macOS MS2PIP/DeepLC annotations differ from the frozen Linux environment and downstream counts exceed tolerance.
msfdr2_smix.decision: Exclude from Ensemble until the annotation environment is reproduced or declared platform-robustness parity passes.

msfdr1_smix.evidence: Frozen fitted-state, MS2Rescore, and target-only parity passed exactly.

ensemble_implementation.explicit_participation: Individual models may use auto or excluded; excluded requires a nonempty reason and Ensemble itself cannot be marked as an excluded expert.
ensemble_implementation.artifact_portability: Lower Order requires successful strict artifact reconstruction; Nokoi v1 always fails portable-artifact admission.
admission_gates: artifact presence, payload, model, provenance, candidate schema, and strict search fingerprint
MS2Rescore artifact validity when the Ensemble consumes annotated evidence
every declared frozen parity stage/layer within tolerance
ensemble_implementation.failure_semantics: Unreadable or missing expert evidence is recorded as an expert gate reason rather than aborting completed core-model work.
ensemble_implementation.insufficient_experts: The lock is written with evaluable=false and explicit reasons; Ensemble stages are skipped. Reusing a non-evaluable lock fails closed.
ensemble_implementation.window_semantics: Accepted experts retain their independently optimized dataset-local windows and artifacts; no combined Ensemble window is optimized.

tests_added_or_extended: explicit Ensemble exclusion requires a reason
Nokoi v1 is diagnostic and rejected for frozen-artifact reuse
Lower Order artifact deserialization rejects incompatible or malformed complete state
independently optimized expert windows are copied into an evaluable lock
explicit exclusion can make a lock non-evaluable without an exception
declared frozen parity failure rejects an expert
malformed expert evidence rejects that expert without aborting lock construction
applying a non-evaluable lock fails closed

verification.json_validation: passed for workflow.example.json, the Phase 8 policy, and this report

pxd_scope.decision: No additional PXD model is required. PXD Moments remains the sole required PXD parity run for this refactor.

release_decision.note: Deferred experts are not marked passed. Ensemble is optional and is evaluable only if enough eligible experts pass every dataset-local runtime gate.
